sql-service.name: rec.rec030.rejectList.cnt.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT COUNT(1) totalcount FROM ( SELECT TREATYBRHCD ORG2_CD ,TREATYBRHNM ORG2_NM ,A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,CON_CON_OLT_PROP_YMD CED_DATE ,USER_ID ,USER_NAME+'('+USER_ID+')' USER_NM ,CON_P_CONT_NAME ,CON_IP_ISD_NAME ,CON_CON_MONTH_PREM MONTH_PREM ,PROD_NM ,NTC_DT ,EST_RESULT_CD ,(SELECT DISTINCT CODE_NAME FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SYS160' AND CODE_ID = B.EST_RESULT_CD) EST_RESULT_NM ,EST_COMMENT ,EST_QC_ID ,(SELECT DISTINCT USER_NAME FROM MS_USERMASTER WHERE USER_ID = B.EST_QC_ID)+'('+EST_QC_ID+')' EST_QC_NM ,EST_DATE FROM MS_REJECT_LIST A LEFT OUTER JOIN MS_EST_HIST B ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO AND B.GUBUN = '1' WHERE CON_CON_OLT_PROP_YMD BETWEEN '?SDATE' AND '?EDATE' ?org1_cd ?org2_flag ?org3_cd ?user_id ?ced_no ?est_rst ?est_yn ?cust_gb ?qc_nm ) A

condition.value: AND A.TREATYBRHCD IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SYS002' AND CODE_ID NOT IN ('KB00','00') AND USE_YN = 'Y')

parameter.name: qc_nm
parameter.value: AND B.EST_QC_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT USER_ID FROM MS_USERMASTER WHERE USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%','?QC_NM','%'))

sql-service.name: rec.rec030.rejectList.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT TREATYBRHCD ORG2_CD ,TREATYBRHNM ORG2_NM ,A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,SUBSTRING(CON_CON_OLT_PROP_YMD,0,9) CED_DATE ,USER_ID ,USER_NAME+'('+USER_ID+')' USER_NM ,CON_P_CONT_NAME ,CON_IP_ISD_NAME ,CON_CON_MONTH_PREM MONTH_PREM ,PROD_NM ,NTC_DT ,EST_RESULT_CD ,(SELECT DISTINCT CODE_NAME FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SYS160' AND CODE_ID = B.EST_RESULT_CD) EST_RESULT_NM ,EST_COMMENT ,EST_QC_ID ,(SELECT DISTINCT USER_NAME FROM MS_USERMASTER WHERE USER_ID = B.EST_QC_ID)+'('+EST_QC_ID+')' EST_QC_NM ,EST_DATE FROM MS_REJECT_LIST A LEFT OUTER JOIN MS_EST_HIST B ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO AND B.GUBUN = '1' WHERE CON_CON_OLT_PROP_YMD BETWEEN '?SDATE' AND '?EDATE' ?org1_cd ?org2_flag ?org3_cd ?user_id ?ced_no ?est_rst ?est_yn ?cust_gb ?qc_nm ORDER BY A.USER_ID, A.CON_P_PSN_NO OFFSET CONVERT(INT,?_START) ROWS FETCH NEXT CONVERT(INT,?_PAGESIZE) ROWS ONLY

condition.value: AND A.TREATYBRHCD IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SYS002' AND CODE_ID NOT IN ('KB00','00') AND USE_YN = 'Y')

parameter.name: qc_nm
parameter.value: AND B.EST_QC_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT USER_ID FROM MS_USERMASTER WHERE USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%','?QC_NM','%'))

sql-service.name: rec.rec030.rejectList.all.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT TREATYBRHCD ORG2_CD ,TREATYBRHNM ORG2_NM ,A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,SUBSTRING(CON_CON_OLT_PROP_YMD,0,9) CED_DATE ,USER_ID ,USER_NAME+'('+USER_ID+')' USER_NM ,CON_P_CONT_NAME ,CON_IP_ISD_NAME ,CON_CON_MONTH_PREM MONTH_PREM ,PROD_NM ,NTC_DT ,EST_RESULT_CD ,(SELECT DISTINCT CODE_NAME FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SYS160' AND CODE_ID = B.EST_RESULT_CD) EST_RESULT_NM ,EST_COMMENT ,EST_QC_ID ,(SELECT DISTINCT USER_NAME FROM MS_USERMASTER WHERE USER_ID = B.EST_QC_ID)+'('+EST_QC_ID+')' EST_QC_NM ,EST_DATE FROM MS_REJECT_LIST A LEFT OUTER JOIN MS_EST_HIST B ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO AND B.GUBUN = '1' WHERE CON_CON_OLT_PROP_YMD BETWEEN '?SDATE' AND '?EDATE' ?org1_cd ?org2_flag ?org3_cd ?user_id ?ced_no ?est_rst ?est_yn ?cust_gb ?qc_nm ORDER BY A.USER_ID, A.CON_P_PSN_NO

parameter.value: AND B.EST_QC_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT USER_ID FROM MS_USERMASTER WHERE USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%','?QC_NM','%'))

sql-service.name: rec.rec030.est_rst_save.upd
sql-service.query: MERGE MS_EST_HIST AS A USING (SELECT 'X' AS DUAL) AS B ON ( GUBUN = ?EST_GUBUN AND CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET EST_RESULT_CD = ?EST_RESULT_CD, EST_COMMENT = ?EST_COMMENT, EST_QC_ID = ?EST_QC_ID, EST_DATE = format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss'), CHG_ID = ?EST_QC_ID, CHG_DATE = format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( GUBUN ,CON_ENT_DGN_NO ,EST_RESULT_CD ,EST_COMMENT ,EST_QC_ID ,EST_DATE ,REG_ID ,REG_DATE ,CHG_ID ,CHG_DATE ) VALUES ( ?EST_GUBUN ,?CON_ENT_DGN_NO ,?EST_RESULT_CD ,?EST_COMMENT ,?EST_QC_ID ,format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') ,?EST_QC_ID ,format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') ,?EST_QC_ID ,format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') );

sql-service.name: rec.rec020T1.getMrlsList.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY a.CENTER_CD, A.AGENT_ID,CUST_ID, REG_DT DESC, A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO) AS No, A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO, A.CENTER_CD, A.CENTER_NM, CONCAT(REC_YN, '/', TM_CNT) AS CNT_STAT, REC_YN, TM_CNT, A.MR_YN, A.LS_YN, A.REG_DT, CONCAT(A.AGENT_NM , '(' , A.AGENT_ID , ')') AS AGENT_NM, AGENT_ID, A.CUST_ID, A.CON_IP_PSN_NAME, A.BIRTH_DT, CASE WHEN B.EST_RESULT_CD IS NULL THEN '대기' ELSE '완료' END AS EST_YN, ISNULL(B.EST_RESULT_CD, '') AS EST_RESULT_CD, B.EST_COMMENT, CASE WHEN B.EST_QC_ID IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT((SELECT USER_NAME FROM MS_USERMASTER WHERE USER_ID = B.EST_QC_ID), '(', B.EST_QC_ID , ')') ELSE '' END AS EST_QC_NM, B.EST_DATE, A.PASS_YN FROM ( SELECT A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO, A.CENTER_CD, A.CENTER_NM, ISNULL(SUM(A.REC_YN),0) AS REC_YN, COUNT(1) AS TM_CNT, (CASE WHEN SUM(MR_YN) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS MR_YN, (CASE WHEN SUM(LS_YN) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS LS_YN, MIN(REG_DT) AS REG_DT, AGENT_ID, AGENT_NM, MAX(CUST_ID) AS CUST_ID, CON_IP_PSN_NAME, BIRTH_DT, (CASE WHEN SUM(PASS_YN) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS PASS_YN FROM (SELECT CON_ENT_DGN_NO, CENTER_CD, CENTER_NM, CASE WHEN (MR_CODE <> '' AND MR_CODE IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MR_YN, CASE WHEN (LS_CODE <> '' AND LS_CODE IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LS_YN, CASE WHEN REC_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS REC_YN, CASE WHEN PASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PASS_YN, REG_DT, AGENT_ID, AGENT_NM, CUST_ID, CON_IP_PSN_NAME, BIRTH_DT FROM MS_MRLS_LIST WHERE 1=1 ?ced_no ?con_ip_psn_name ?org1_cd ?org2_flag ?org3_cd ?user_id ) A GROUP BY A.con_ent_dgn_no, A.CENTER_CD, A.CENTER_NM, A.AGENT_ID, A.AGENT_NM,A.CON_IP_PSN_NAME, BIRTH_DT HAVING MIN(REG_DT) BETWEEN '?sdate' AND '?edate' ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN MS_EST_HIST B ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO WHERE 1=1 ?est_date_flag ?est_rst ?est_yn ?qc_nm ORDER BY a.CENTER_CD, A.AGENT_ID,CUST_ID, REG_DT DESC, A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO OFFSET CONVERT(INT,?_START) ROWS FETCH NEXT CONVERT(INT,?_PAGESIZE) ROWS ONLY

parameter.name: org1_cd
parameter.value: AND CENTER_CD IN (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM MS_DEPT WHERE UPPER_DEPT ='?ORG1_CD')

condition.value: AND CENTER_CD IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SYS002' AND CODE_ID NOT IN ('KB00','00') AND USE_YN = 'Y')

parameter.name: org3_cd
parameter.value: AND AGENT_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM MS_USERMASTER WHERE TREATYDEPTCD = '?ORG3_CD')

parameter.name: qc_nm
parameter.value: AND B.EST_QC_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT USER_ID FROM MS_USERMASTER WHERE USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%','?QC_NM','%'))

sql-service.name: rec.rec020T1.getMrlsList.totCount.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT COUNT(1) AS TOT_CNT FROM ( SELECT A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO, A.CENTER_CD, A.CENTER_NM, ISNULL(SUM(A.REC_YN),0) AS REC_YN, (CASE WHEN SUM(MR_YN) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS MR_YN, (CASE WHEN SUM(LS_YN) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS LS_YN, MIN(REG_DT) AS REG_DT, AGENT_ID, AGENT_NM, MAX(CUST_ID) AS CUST_ID, CON_IP_PSN_NAME, BIRTH_DT, (CASE WHEN SUM(PASS_YN) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS PASS_YN FROM (SELECT CON_ENT_DGN_NO, CENTER_CD, CENTER_NM, CASE WHEN (MR_CODE <> '' OR MR_CODE IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MR_YN, CASE WHEN (LS_CODE <> '' OR LS_CODE IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LS_YN, CASE WHEN REC_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS REC_YN, CASE WHEN PASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PASS_YN, REG_DT, AGENT_ID, AGENT_NM, CUST_ID, CON_IP_PSN_NAME, BIRTH_DT FROM MS_MRLS_LIST WHERE 1=1 ?ced_no ?con_ip_psn_name ?org1_cd ?org2_flag ?org3_cd ?user_id ) A GROUP BY A.con_ent_dgn_no, A.CENTER_CD, A.CENTER_NM, A.AGENT_ID, A.AGENT_NM, A.CON_IP_PSN_NAME, BIRTH_DT HAVING MIN(REG_DT) BETWEEN '?sdate' AND '?edate' ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN MS_EST_HIST B ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO WHERE 1=1 ?est_date_flag ?est_rst ?est_yn ?qc_nm

parameter.name: org1_cd
parameter.value: AND CENTER_CD IN (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM MS_DEPT WHERE UPPER_DEPT ='?ORG1_CD')

condition.value: AND CENTER_CD IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SYS002' AND CODE_ID NOT IN ('KB00','00') AND USE_YN = 'Y')

parameter.name: org3_cd
parameter.value: AND AGENT_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM MS_USERMASTER WHERE TREATYDEPTCD = '?ORG3_CD')

parameter.name: qc_nm
parameter.value: AND B.EST_QC_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT USER_ID FROM MS_USERMASTER WHERE USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%','?QC_NM','%'))

sql-service.query: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY a.CENTER_CD, A.AGENT_ID,CUST_ID, REG_DT DESC, A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO) AS No, A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO, A.CENTER_CD, A.CENTER_NM, CONCAT(REC_YN,'/',TM_CNT) AS CNT_STAT, REC_YN, TM_CNT, A.MR_YN, A.LS_YN, A.REG_DT, CONCAT(A.AGENT_NM , '(' , A.AGENT_ID , ')') AS AGENT_NM, AGENT_ID, A.CUST_ID, A.CON_IP_PSN_NAME, A.BIRTH_DT, CASE WHEN B.EST_RESULT_CD IS NULL THEN '대기' ELSE '완료' END AS EST_YN, ISNULL(B.EST_RESULT_CD, '') AS EST_RESULT_CD, B.EST_COMMENT, CASE WHEN B.EST_QC_ID IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT((SELECT USER_NAME FROM MS_USERMASTER WHERE USER_ID = B.EST_QC_ID), '(', B.EST_QC_ID , ')') ELSE '' END AS EST_QC_NM, B.EST_DATE, A.PASS_YN, (CASE WHEN (select count(1) from MS_MRLS_LIST where REG_DT BETWEEN '?sdate' AND '?edate' and CENTER_CD = MIN(REG_DT) AS REG_DT, AGENT_ID, AGENT_NM, CUST_ID AS CUST_ID, CON_IP_PSN_NAME, BIRTH_DT, (CASE WHEN SUM(PASS_YN) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS PASS_YN FROM (SELECT CON_ENT_DGN_NO, CENTER_CD, CENTER_NM, CASE WHEN (MR_CODE <> '' AND MR_CODE IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MR_YN, CASE WHEN (LS_CODE <> '' AND LS_CODE IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LS_YN, CASE WHEN REC_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ?org2_flag ?org3_cd ?user_id ) A GROUP BY A.con_ent_dgn_no, A.CENTER_CD, A.CENTER_NM, A.AGENT_ID, A.AGENT_NM, A.CON_IP_PSN_NAME, A.CUST_ID, BIRTH_DT HAVING MIN(REG_DT) BETWEEN '?sdate' AND '?edate' ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN MS_EST_HIST B ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO WHERE 1=1 ?est_date_flag ?est_rst ?est_yn ?qc_nm ORDER BY a.CENTER_CD, A.AGENT_ID,CUST_ID, REG_DT DESC, A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO

sql-service.query: SELECT CON_ENT_DGN_NO, UCID, ISNULL(MR_CODE,'') AS MR_CODE, ISNULL(LS_CODE,'') AS LS_CODE FROM ms_mrls_list with(nolock) WHERE 1=1 AND CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?ced_no ORDER BY CON_ENT_DGN_NO, UCID

sql-service.name: rec.rec020t1.getUcid.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT FILEID UCID, substring(RECSTARTDT,0,5)+'-'+substring(RECSTARTDT,5,2)+'-'+substring(RECSTARTDT,7,2)+' '+substring(RECSTARTDT,9,2)+':'+substring(RECSTARTDT,11,2)+':'+substring(RECSTARTDT,13,2) UCID_DATE, OrgFileFullPath FILE_FULL_PATH, '' AS DATETIME, '' ANL_STAT FROM Sponsor_CallInfo A WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE 1=1 ?ced_no ?ucid ORDER BY UCID_DATE DESC

sql-service.name: rec.rec020t2.notmatchedList.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY RecStartDT, TPANO) AS No, FILEID, SpCode, RecStartDT, OrgFileFullPath AS FILE_PATH, TPANO, CASE WHEN (MR_Code = '' OR MR_Code IS NULL) THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS MR_YN, CASE WHEN (LS_Code = '' OR LS_Code IS NULL) THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS LS_YN, AgentName, CustomerName FROM Sponsor_CallInfo WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE 1=1 AND RecStartDT BETWEEN '?SDATE' AND '?EDATE' AND SpCode <> '30384' AND ISNULL(MR_CODE,'') <> 'M0000000001' AND ISNULL(LS_CODE,'') <> 'F0000000001' ?spcode ?cust_nm ?ced_no ?mrls_gb ?agent_nm ORDER BY RecStartDT, TPANO OFFSET CONVERT(INT,?_START) ROWS FETCH NEXT CONVERT(INT,?_PAGESIZE) ROWS ONLY

sql-service.name: rec.rec020t2.notmatchedList.totCount.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT count(1) as cnt FROM Sponsor_CallInfo WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE 1=1 AND RecStartDT BETWEEN '?SDATE' AND '?EDATE' AND SpCode <> '30384' AND ISNULL(MR_CODE,'') <> 'M0000000001' AND ISNULL(LS_CODE,'') <> 'F0000000001' ?spcode ?cust_nm ?ced_no ?mrls_gb ?agent_nm
